race.comment: A break proved costly for KINGMAN NZ (3) when attempting to defend his NZ Cup title at Addington last week but he was building nicely prior with two strong efforts behind Captains Mistress, finishing fourth from the back line in the Victoria Cup and coming from a similar barrier to this for a 4m second to the star mare the last time he raced here. That result is a good pointer to this. HI MANAMEISJEFF NZ (7) has been targeting this race and is in peak form at the right time with back-to-back wins at this circuit and distance, leading from this barrier to cruise home last week. He is a Menangle specialist and this looks his chance to land the Group 1 he deserves. DANGEROUS (10) was no match for Hi Manameisjeff as runner-up last week and draws wide again but he was first up for four weeks there so may be improved and did kick off the campaign with back to-back wins at the circuit and distance. BULLETPROOF BOY (4) won the Newcastle Mile the last time he came to NSW. respect from a good draw.
